title: Lake Champlain Angler Fishing Charters

services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Updated April 16, 2026: The lake opened up about two weeks ago by a gale force wind, sinking the last few sheets of ice on the very north end. My first opportunity came April 8th. I picked my best weather to fish as it has been very windy. Decided to fish shallow right away and it paid off. Some of the better ones I boated over the last four trips, chunky largemouth, big pickerel and a colorful rudd. Updated March 17, 2026: Lake Champlain is mostly ice covered, but lake levels are rising and areas still iced over are seeing ice separating from the shoreline. blurb: Guided fishing trips with a tenured Lake Champlain Master Captain, targeting smallmouth and largemouth bass, northern pike and lake trout. Mick was raised on his family compound, along the shores of the lake, since the age of one. He has twenty years chartering on the New York and Vermont waters of Lake Champlain.
